_comment: Anthropic effort arm 'max', second series, for Day-to-Day Bench task set v1. Same tasks, graders, output limits (4,096 tokens, reasoning included), judges and repeats as run-config.json; the three Anthropic models at reasoning_effort max. The only difference from the first Anthropic series is caps_usd, which follows the raised Anthropic ledger ceiling in config.py. Must run while the gpt-6.1-terra judge is available. Results are a separate, labelled run.
approved_by: Kol (repo owner): typed go for paid bench runs on 15 November 2026; on 17 and 18 November 2026 asked for the prepaid API credit to be used on benchmarking. Amounts and approval detail are recorded privately.

canary._comment: Second canary, 15 November 2026. The first (run 2026-11-15T031058Z-aa0ee142) took the default two tasks, both short and script-graded, so it proved the transport and the charges and nothing else. These two exercise what it missed: f5-pub-03 has five judged checks and a long prompt, f7-pub-05 is graded by tests in the sandbox.

_judge_candidates_comment: The qualify stage tries every candidate against the frozen samples, cheapest first, and names the panel: on each side the cheapest candidate that passed. Then set judges to that panel. A judge verdict is a small JSON object, so every judge and candidate has an output limit of 400 tokens.
